quest.title: Garcia's Paean: Substitutes
quest.description: Garcia seems to have run into trouble again...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, I most sincerely suggest that we find a way to pay.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: They were more like bandits than merchants! How could they ask for such a high price for just a couple of insignias?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Perhaps they noticed how your eyes lit up when you saw their goods.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you want the insignias for?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler! Your timing is always most opportune...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help last time, I have basically produced an acceptable lubricant.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: However, I encountered another problem soon after that. While reproducing some of the parts, I found that... their excessively hard material will damage the other parts.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Moreover, these excessively hard parts would crack, to different extents, upon even the slightest impact...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Thus, I began searching for a material that is both hard and flexible.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: After relentless research...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: ...And after relentlessly hassling Mr. Ahangar.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I thought that I could find the material I sought in the insignias that the Treasure Hoarders carry around with them.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: But those merchants may as well have been Treasure Hoarders, the way they were robbing me!

choices.text: So this is where I come in, yes?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I should carve your name on the main bearing of my Numbering Machine! I can't express my gratitude enough!

choices.text: Eh, I'll help you find some.

talks.objective: Obtain Treasures Hoarders' insignias for Garcia

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I assume you have obtained the insignias, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, Traveler. These should suffice.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I will have to reproduce the gear first... Um, no, I should tackle the problem with the bearings first...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Here's your payment, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Given the current circumstances, we are probably in for some long-term cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Ugh, Mr. Garcia's accounts... Sorting them out really is a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Oh my! These insignias certainly are of high quality!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I will have to reproduce the gear first... Um, no, I should tackle the problem with the bearings first...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Here's your payment, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Given the current circumstances, we are probably in for some long-term cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Ugh, Mr. Garcia's accounts... Sorting them out really is a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I submit that we must earn some Mora, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I have heard that there is a theater in Sumeru City and that they are looking for someone to do some calculations for them.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Besides, the stage crew... You know, they earn quite some Mora, but they have no idea how to keep track of it.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I sense opportunity here, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Why, your talent in accounting and business is most astounding, my dear Lutong...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Still, give me a second, let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Ugh... Lutong, I need a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, you'd better go back and get some sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Traveler, perfect timing! Come over here. I would like to ask a favor of you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with him?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Well, in a word... Mr. Garcia had too much coffee and too little sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Fortunately, it's coffee he drank, not wine.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Lutong, uh... We have to find some more insignias... You know, the ones that the Treasure Hoarders carry around with them...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler! You are here. Sorry, I didn't see you there.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Would you like to get me some of those insignias? Just a few will do.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: It's okay. I'm fine. I know what I'm doing. It's just that my hands play tricks on me.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Anyway, please bring back some insignias, and you will get paid.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Once you've got it, just bring it to me. I want to take a closer look. A perfect bearing must be made this time...

choices.text: Never thought coffee was that effective.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It's not the coffee. Mr. Garcia doesn't want to sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Luckily, Mr. Garcia doesn't drink...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been in correspondence with Kaia?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, Ms. Kaia hasn't sent back any letters yet.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: And my plan to send letters to Ms. Kaia failed because I didn't know where to send them...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Have no idea where Ms. Kaia is traveling now...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Well, these insignias will be enough. I... Ugh! My head is starting to hurt again.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir! You have to take these pills right now!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Traveler, please take these as your reward. I'll take Mr. Garcia back first.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Insignias! Don't forget the insignias. Make sure they are kept properly!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Don't worry sir. They are absolutely safe with me.
